Done! I've added the `create_invoice_handler` function to `invoicing/api.py`. 

The implementation:
- Parses the request body to extract invoice id and line items
- Validates each item by creating a `LineItem` object (which raises `InvoiceError("BAD_QTY", ...)` if qty ≤ 0)
- Creates an `Invoice` with the user as the customer
- Saves it via `service.create()`
- Returns `(201, {"id", "created"})` on success
- Returns `(400, {"error": code})` if any item validation fails

**All tests pass** ✅ (10/10 tests passed)
